title: Queerfeindliche Straftaten – Streit im Fitnessstudio und Vorfall an einem Bahnhof

extraction.summaryEn: A 30-year-old was verbally abused and threatened with a raised hand in a gym's changing area in an anti-queer attack; the suspect left before police arrived. Staatsschutz is investigating a politically motivated threat case. A second anti-queer incident the same day at Landsberger Allee involved a knife shown and kicking gestures; the suspects fled.
